definitions.evaluation: Fixed preprocessed cases; raw and EMA use identical fixed endpoint noise, independent of optimizer step.
definitions.ema: EMA weights; 1-NFE image reconstruction on the same model, temporarily loaded and restored.
definitions.prior: Mean of the three conditioning MRIs via WFM wavelet scaling, with the same image clamp/background mask; no noise, no network call.
definitions.mse: Mean squared image reconstruction error, including background.
definitions.mae: Mean absolute image reconstruction error, including background.
definitions.psnr: -10*log10(MSE) with fixed data_range=1; perfect +inf is null in JSON and omitted from TensorBoard.
definitions.ssim: True 3D SSIM, unit data range, largest odd cubic window <=7; valid window interior only.
definitions.brain_metrics: Target>0 foreground; brain SSIM uses foreground centers with complete 3D windows.
definitions.macro: Arithmetic mean of defined per-subject/per-modality scores, with equal weights; nonfinite averages remain null.
definitions.image_scale: MRI and absolute-error panels share [0,1]; wavelets share a labelled symmetric scale per comparison band.
definitions.geometry: Three center planes are labelled array axis0/axis1/axis2; no anatomical orientation is inferred.
